name: private-line
description: Private Line: a two-person Android messenger with calls, activated by a pair code and protected by a PIN.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-www.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-private-line "node test/e2e.js"
